existing_protocol_scope_discrepancy: perception.json also specifies counter_to_cab and counter_to_sink as a two-task RoboCasa 25/25 gate. This freeze does not waive counter_to_cab; reconcile that gate before any eligibility decision.

development.stability: one predeclared policy attempt per seed 101 through 125, 25/25 native successes for each task

split.note: Seeds 106 through 110 are development seeds even when reserved by a prior Memory validation plan.

robot_policy.selection: one independently reviewed, approved public-SDK policy per task; freeze policy source, task config, generation receipt and M1 entry lock byte SHA-256 before the first chain case; no substitution after seeing outcomes
prohibited_evidence: Memory control/treatment pairs counted as unpaired task stability

condition_rules.assistance_mode: benchmark_proxy; fixed proxy latency 2 seconds; no live human in primary matrix
condition_rules.demo_first: preapproved public SDK video or at most 32-step public SDK trajectory, manifest and assets byte-SHA locked before attempt 0; no online help after demo; absent approved demo blocks this condition
condition_rules.retry_k_then_ask: freeze integer k in approved policy config before results
condition_rules.budget_matched_random_escalation: preregister target_request_count from the planned full-method quota before either arm has outcomes; require target <= assistance credits and failure slots; rank failure slots by SHA-256(seed:failure_slot); record selected, realized and shortfall if early success
condition_rules.trace_aware_hint_only: Advisor-visible public Trace projection only; no trusted Memory retrieval
condition_rules.full_trace_aware_attention_planner: public Trace, bounded Advisor, and only Service-issued exact-version trusted Memory grant in matched applicability scope; independent unsafe signal interrupts before deliberation
condition_rules.matrix_execution: not authorized by this admission freeze; run only after every admission gate passes

budget.pre_admission_chain: at most five new real development cases per task, one per seed 101-105, only after policy/config/approval lock; stop at first unsafe, unknown action, missing artifact or version drift
budget.pre_admission_stability: at most 25 new real development cases per task, one per seed 101-125, only after chain passes; chain cases may count only if all identity and success criteria match the frozen stability policy and configuration; no outcome-dependent replacement

admission_gates.five_seed_chain_each_task: all five planned seeds 101-105 complete reset, sim_gt find_objects provenance, public action, suite native evaluator, raw/public Trace, Advisor boundary, Memory scope/provenance, no-op negative control where applicable, independent Safety, four formal artifact hashes, and Service stop receipts
admission_gates.stability_each_task: 25/25 predeclared development seeds 101-125 have native_success=true with evaluated=true under the same frozen public policy/config and exact software versions; no failed or invalid case may be silently excluded or replaced
admission_gates.safety: zero unsafe or unknown-action attempts in qualifying cases; independent Safety is authoritative and cannot be overridden by policy or evaluator
admission_gates.trusted_memory: versioned Service promotion, matching scene/object/camera/variant/task/perception scope, exact per-attempt grant, raw retrieval/use evidence and lifecycle/scope rejection; usage evidence is not task stability evidence
admission_gates.depth_500: root cause remains unresolved; a no-reproduction window is not a fix. Admission requires a separately justified bias-control decision; if stop/invalid rules cannot prevent outcome-dependent attrition, fail closed.

outcomes_and_reporting.success: native evaluator Boolean only; report numerator/denominator per task, seed and condition, and all failed attempts
outcomes_and_reporting.safety: independent unsafe attempt count, unknown action count, stop latency and Service reaping; report every event and zero-event totals
outcomes_and_reporting.attention: requests, realized credits, input/output/total tokens, response latency, robot/wall time, demo use and Memory version/grants/uses
outcomes_and_reporting.invalid_pair: retain both planned arms, their outcomes and SHA; mark pair invalid on unknown action, missing/bad artifact, wrong version/scope, lost Service receipt or unbalanced budget. Do not replace seed or rerun within frozen matrix; report planned, valid, invalid and reason counts; block gate if invalidity can bias success comparison.
outcomes_and_reporting.exception: stop affected attempt on HTTP 500, invalid depth or unknown action; independent Safety records unsafe; preserve raw .npy, HTTP/Service stderr, four artifacts, receipt and SHA; report failure and invalidity separately, never convert to success or fixed
outcomes_and_reporting.early_success: report fewer realized attempts/requests as observed, including random matching shortfall; do not impute unused budget or add attempts
outcomes_and_reporting.revision: any software/policy/config/demo/plan change requires a new immutable protocol version and independent admission audit; preserve old failures
